relevance_note: Narrative review of retinal vasculitis that mentions A20 haploinsufficiency only at group level, summarising reference 12 ("Patients present early in life with oral ulcers, pathergy, dermal abscesses, chorioretinal scarring, and macular fibrosis secondary to retinal vasculitis"), with no identifiable person carrying a TNFAIP3 variant.
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; no script transcribed any table. The only individual described in any detail (Figures 1-2: a 25 year-old Saudi male diagnosed with Behcet's disease) has no TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis and is out of scope, so the individuals, variants, phenotypic_features and phenotype_checklist tables are empty. The TNFAIP3 passage cites reference [12**] (Zhou Q et al., 2016, Nat Genet, PMID:26642243) and describes those patients only collectively, without counts or individual detail, so n_patients_reported is null. The patient numbers in the text (e.g. 'our own series of 207 patients', 45, 6075, 132, 124, 164 patients) belong to cited studies, not to a cohort of this review, so cohort_size_as_stated is null. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null rather than false because the review has no patients of its own and no quote states either way. No contradictions relevant to the extraction were found (the Key Points list numbers two items '2)', and the Table 1 notes repeat a sentence; neither affects any value).

study_type.span: This review focuses on new developments in the understanding and treatment of retinal vasculitis.
